    What 7 holidays is Costco closed?

    AI Overview
    Costco warehouses and gas stations in the U.S. are closed for
    seven major holidays each year to allow employees time off: 
    • New Year's Day
    • Easter Sunday
    • Memorial Day
    • Independence Day
    • Labor Day
    • Thanksgiving Day
    • Christmas Day
       
    These closures allow employees to enjoy family and community celebrations. For updated information, you can use the Find a Warehouse feature at Costco.com to check for other potential adjusted operating hours.
